name_zh: 扎耶德/阿联酋/联邦/石油/宽容/女性/太空/火星
core_mode: M547 联邦建国/石油宽容/女性权利/火星探测/迪拜模式
intellectual_tradition: 海湾联邦君主制/后石油愿景/宽容国家学说
description_zh: 扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬 (1918-2004) 是阿联酋建国总统 (1971-2004)，建立了七酋长国联邦，实现石油财富的平等分配和广泛福利，推行宽容政策吸引外籍人口达90%，是女性权利的先驱，支持火星探测计划（希望号），并将其愿景传承给子孙。迪拜模式是其联邦制度的典范体现。
description_en: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (1918-2004) was the founding President of UAE (1971-2004), established seven-emirates federation, implemented oil wealth distribution free welfare, promoted tolerance policy attracted 90% expatriate population, pioneered women rights, supported Mars exploration (Hope Probe), and inherited his vision to descendants. Dubai model is exemplary federation system.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M547(联邦建国/石油宽容/女性权利/火星探测/迪拜模式)、150(塔木德辩证/哲学)、153(儒商传承/流散智慧)、57(国家学说/文明融合)、124(全球视野/跨文明交流)。扎耶德体现了部落联邦向现代国家的转型智慧，通过石油财富和宽容政策实现国家整合，将女性赋权和太空愿景作为后石油时代国家品牌的核心，其联邦模式为海湾地区提供了制度蓝本。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M547(Federation/Oil Tolerance/Women Rights/Mars探测/Dubai模式)、150(Talmudic Dialectics/Philosophy)、153(Ju-Shang Inheritance/Diaspora Wisdom)、57(Nation Building/Civilization融合)、124(Global Vision/Cross-Civilization交流)。Zayed embodies tribal federation to modern nation transformation wisdom through oil wealth and tolerance policies, realizing national integration, positioning women empowerment and space vision as post-oil era national brand core, his federation model providing institutional blueprint for Gulf cooperation.
steps_zh: 第1步：系统思维法——联邦建国：从部落联盟到现代国家
第2步：包容思维法——财富分配：石油财富的平等分配和广泛福利
第3步：未来思维法——太空愿景：火星探测计划和后石油时代愿景
第4步：文化融合思维法——女性赋权：推动女性权利和性别平等
第5步：城市发展思维法——迪拜模式：建立现代城市中心
steps_en: Step 1: Systems Thinking Method - Federation building: from tribal alliance to modern nation
Step 2: Inclusion Thinking Method - Wealth distribution: oil wealth equal distribution and extensive welfare
Step 3: Future Thinking Method - Space vision: Mars exploration program and post-oil era vision
Step 4: Cultural Fusion Thinking Method - Women empowerment: promote women rights and gender equality
Step 5: Urban Development Thinking Method - Dubai model: establish modern urban center

expected_en: Realize transformation from tribal federation to modern nation
Establish oil wealth sustainable welfare system
Establish institutional blueprint for regional cooperation
Create sustainable national brand and vision
